from forte2 import AVAS, CI, GHF, RelCISolver, System

xyz = """
N 0.0000000000 0.0000000000 0.0000000000
N 0.0000000000 0.0000000000 1.2000000000
"""

system = System(
    xyz=xyz,
    basis_set="cc-pvdz",
    auxiliary_basis_set="def2-universal-jkfit",
    minao_basis_set="cc-pvtz-minao",
    x2c_type="so",
)

mf = GHF(charge=0)(system)

avas = AVAS(
    subspace=["N(2p)"],
    selection_method="separate",
    num_active_docc=6,
    num_active_uocc=6,
    diagonalize=True,
)(mf)

ci = CI(RelCISolver(nel=mf.nel))(avas)
ci.run()
